rationale: Multiple independent signals confirm that SEO professionals are actively spending money on AEO/AI-search optimization while lacking any reliable feedback mechanism. Existing paid tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Semji) are beginning to add AI-visibility features, confirming willingness to pay, but none yet offer a dedicated AEO audit loop. At least 5 distinct pain expressions found across Stack Exchange, Reddit, LinkedIn, and specialist SEO forums.
